edits.en:
Link your clear records from Super Robot Wars Z3: Jigoku-hen and
Rengoku-hen to receive bonuses such as funds and Power Parts at the
start of this game. Linking requires system data containing clear records
from Jigoku-hen, Rengoku-hen, or both. If you cannot link Rengoku-hen
at the start of the game, you can also link it later from intermission.
